source_refs.note: Topic 5.1.3 (PDF 127-128, printed 124-125). MCQ 6 is answered (a), matching the key. Short question 6 is answered.

items: Weather forecasting: meteorologists collect temperature, humidity and wind speed and use models to forecast the weather.
Financial predictions: banks and companies predict economic trends, stock prices and customer behaviour.
Scientific research: models test theories, explore ideas and make predictions; machine learning and artificial intelligence have made them more powerful on large data.

blocks.prompt: Which is a real-world application of statistical models (MCQ 6)? Give an example of a problem where a statistical model could be applied (short question 6).
blocks.explanation: (a) predicting house prices. Another example: predicting a fruit stall's daily earnings from the number of customers, as in topic 5.4.1.2, or a farmer's best planting time from weather data.

items: Applications: weather forecasting, finance, scientific research (more powerful with ML and AI).
